    a = np.asarray(a, np.float64); b = np.asarray(b, np.float64)

    """Wells on the plate, laid out in `rows` rows (along x, `spacing` apart; the rows `spacing` apart along y, first row nearest to

    n = len(wells)

 def move(X,Y,z,speed=.18,settle=3):
  x,y=s.geo.mm_to_world(X,Y);return mv([x,y,z],speed=speed,settle=settle)
 def dip(k):
  w=s.wells()[k];x,y=w['center_xy'];mv([x,y,.06],speed=.25,settle=2);mv([x,y,.023],speed=.12,settle=3);mv([x,y,.06],speed=.18,settle=2)
 s.record_start()
 for i,st in enumerate(strokes[:limit]):
  x0,y0,x1,y1,w,col=st;scale=227.1845/256;x0,y0,x1,y1=np.array([x0,y0,x1,y1])*scale
  width=w*scale;d=float(np.interp(width,[3.99,5.77,6.43,7.99,9.32,10.87],[1.5,2,3,4,5,6.3]))
  dip(int(col));move(x0,y0,.05)

   print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'seconds',time.time()-start,flush=True)

 a=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(a,path);Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(ROOT+'/actual.png');np.save(ROOT+'/actual_ink.npy',s.ink())

 return s
